scripts.theme: vp exec astryx theme build src/theme.ts --out src/lib/generated/stone.css
scripts.build: vp run build:views && vp run check:docs && vp run typecheck && react-router build --mode api --logLevel warn && react-router build --mode sdk --logLevel warn
scripts.typecheck: vp run typecheck:api && vp run typecheck:sdk
scripts.build:api: vp run build:views && vp run check:docs && vp run typecheck:api && react-router build --mode api
scripts.build:api:container: vp run build:views && vp run generate:docs && vp run typecheck:api && react-router build --mode api
scripts.build:api:bundle: vp run build:views && vp run check:docs && react-router build --mode api
scripts.build:sdk: vp run build:views && vp run typecheck:sdk && react-router build --mode sdk
scripts.build:sdk:bundle: vp run build:views && react-router build --mode sdk
scripts.check:platform-api: vp run generate:platform-api && git diff --exit-code -- ../api/openapi/v1.json src/lib/generated/platform-api-v1
scripts.dev: vp run build:views && react-router dev --mode api
scripts.dev:sdk: vp run build:views && react-router dev --mode sdk
